name: Roasted Pumpkin Barley Risotto
steps: Roast the pumpkin at 200°C for 20 minutes until tender and slightly caramelised.
Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic for 4 minutes. Add the barley and herbs and stir for 1 minute.
Add the stock a ladleful at a time, simmering for about 30 minutes, until the barley is tender and creamy.
Mash half the pumpkin into the risotto and fold in the rest with the beans.
Stir in the nutritional yeast, season, and finish with parsley.
note: Barley risotto is lower in glycaemic load than rice risotto and stays creamy without butter or cheese.
